title: Dragons Add-On
alt: Custom dragon entities for Minecraft Bedrock
description: Custom dragon entities built from the ground up — multi-phase AI, bespoke animations, and all art assets. An early project that pushed me deep into complex boss behavior design.

title: Mutants Add-On
alt: Overhauled mutant variants of classic Bedrock mobs
description: Mutant variants of classic Minecraft mobs — each with reworked behaviors, unique attacks, and new animations. Contributed across the full pipeline as both developer and artist.

title: Into The Wild
alt: Wildlife and ecosystem expansion for Bedrock
description: New creatures, ambient behaviors, and biome-specific wildlife brought into Minecraft Bedrock. Focused on making the world feel more alive with minimal gameplay friction.

title: Backrooms Add-On
alt: The Backrooms recreated in Minecraft Bedrock
description: The Backrooms experience built in Bedrock — liminal environments, custom entities that don't behave like normal mobs, and atmosphere-first design. One of the more creatively unusual projects I've worked on.

title: Weapons Expansion
alt: Large-scale weapons add-on for Minecraft Bedrock
description: A wide arsenal of new weapons for Bedrock, done right visually. Led the art direction — setting the quality bar, reviewing assets, and keeping the visual language consistent across a large item set.

title: Survival+
description: A deep overhaul of Bedrock's survival loop — new mechanics, items, and systems layered on top of the base game without breaking what makes it feel like Minecraft. Led the branch as project and art lead.

title: Survival+ Demons
description: A dark expansion branch for Survival+ introducing infernal entities, environments, and encounters. Handled the art direction and asset creation for the full demon roster.

title: Weapons Expansion 3
alt: Third entry in the Weapons Expansion series
description: Third in the series — raised the visual standard again with more refined assets and a tighter art pipeline. Continued as art director, keeping quality consistent across an ever-growing item count.
